name: 晨光山涧 · 三维骑手

layers.name: 天空
layers.describe_zh: 黎明的天空，从顶部深蓝一路渐变到地平线的暖金色，没有云
layers.describe_en: a dawn sky graduating from deep blue at the top to warm gold at the horizon, cloudless

layers.name: 远山
layers.describe_zh: 一排覆雪的远峰，浅米白，轮廓柔和，被空气冲淡
layers.describe_en: a distant range of snow-covered peaks in pale cream, soft outlines, hazy with atmosphere

layers.name: 近山
layers.describe_zh: 三座更近的雪峰，蓝灰色，压在中景，山脊陡峭
layers.describe_en: three nearer snow peaks in slate blue-grey in the middle distance, steep ridges

layers.name: 岩地
layers.describe_zh: 裸露的岩石坡，深蓝灰，向画面下方倾斜，散落着碎石
layers.describe_en: a bare rocky slope in deep blue-grey, tilting down toward the viewer, scattered with loose stones

layers.name: 河流
layers.describe_zh: 山涧溪流横过画面下方，深蓝水面，五道起伏的白色波浪，波峰带小水花
layers.describe_en: a mountain stream running across the lower edge, deep blue water cut by five wavy white ripples with small splashes

layers.name: 马影
layers.describe_zh: 马脚下的一块深色地面投影
layers.describe_en: a dark contact shadow under the horse

layers.name: 骑手
layers.describe_zh: 拿破仑骑在花白马背上，戴双角帽，深蓝军装配金色滚边，白裤黑靴，右手高举指向前方，赭红斗篷在身后展开，两条腿弯曲垂在马身两侧，脚踩马镫
layers.describe_en: Napoleon on the dappled horse, black bicorne hat, dark blue uniform with gold trim, white breeches, tall black boots, his right arm raised pointing forward, a crimson cloak billowing behind, both legs bent and hanging on either side of the horse with feet in the stirrups

layers.name: 前景
layers.describe_zh: 几块深色巨石压在画面底部，把画面收住
layers.describe_en: several dark boulders anchoring the bottom edge

brief_zh.subject: 拿破仑·波拿巴骑着花白骏马站在阿尔卑斯山的岩坡上，右手高举指向前方
brief_zh.style: 新古典主义油画，可见笔触，强烈的明暗对比
brief_zh.light: 黎明侧光，地平线暖金，山体冷蓝
brief_zh.palette: 赭石、焦褐、深红、浅金、冷灰

brief_en.subject: Napoleon Bonaparte on a dappled grey horse standing on a rocky Alpine slope, right arm raised pointing forward
brief_en.style: neoclassical oil painting with visible brushwork and strong chiaroscuro
brief_en.light: dawn side light, warm gold at the horizon, cold blue on the mountains
brief_en.palette: ochre, burnt umber, deep crimson, pale gold and cold grey
